typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		SubscriberID as string,
		First_Name as string,
		Last_Name as string,
		Address1 as string,
		Address2 as string,
		Address3 as string,
		City as string,
		State as string,
		Zip as string,
		DOB as timestamp,
		{Eligibility Begin date} as date,
		{Eligibility End date} as date,
		{Eligibility Status} as string,
		Source as string,
		Reason as string,
		applicationname as string,
		calltime as timestamp,
		RCRD_STTS_CD as string,
		VRSN_OPEN_DT as timestamp,
		SRC_ADRS_TYPE_CD as string,
		MBR_KEY as string,
		ReportMonth as timestamp,
		Createdate as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select * from ##finalresult',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of Address3} = toString(Address3),
		{Copy of Address2} = toString(Address2),
		{Copy of Createdate} = Createdate,
		{Copy of First_Name} = toString(First_Name),
		{Copy of Last_Name} = toString(Last_Name),
		{Copy of Zip} = toString(Zip),
		{Copy of City} = toString(City),
		{Copy of Reason} = toString(Reason),
		{Copy of DOB} = toString(DOB),
		{Copy of Address1} = toString(Address1),
		{Copy of State} = toString(State),
		{Copy of applicationname} = toString(applicationname),
		{Copy of calltime} = calltime,
		{Copy of Source} = toString(Source),
		{Copy of ReportMonth} = ReportMonth,
		{Copy of SubscriberID} = toString(SubscriberID)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
